about_the_game:
Welcome to The Life Together Online – a life simulation game!

A Living World Filled with Players

The Life Together Online is a reimagining and evolution of past project ideas, brought to life as an online world where players from all over the globe can connect, make new friends, enjoy their time or develop their characters.

A World Where Every Character Is a Real Person

Every character you see* is a real player behind the screen, with their own unpredictability, mysteries and goals. You’ll meet unique individuals you may never encounter again, making every interaction special.

Create Your Unique Character

Design your one of a kind character with a flexible appearance editor. Express yourself through clothing, hairstyles, tattoos or makeup. Bring your individuality to life and immerse yourself in this vibrant world!

Home Is Where You Choose

You can create your own server, join an existing one or freely travel between worlds built by other players. As a resident of a server, you’ll have the opportunity to purchase a unique home that no one else can own, becoming part of a local community, making neighbors, and welcoming guests. If you prefer freedom, you can stay in hotels without being tied to a specific residence - perfect for travelers or those not ready to invest in real estate. Everything depends on your preferences - no restrictions!

Customize and Furnish Your Home

The game offers extensive customization options for your home. The city features various stores where you can purchase furniture, lighting, surface materials and electronics. You can transport your purchases yourself or load them into your car, then arrange everything in your home in real time with no limitations.

Choose Your Career and Lifestyle

Forge your own path in life. You can get a job, become part of a community and provide services to other players - whether as a bartender in a local venue, a sales manager in a store or a barista at a café. If you value freedom, you can work as a delivery driver, completing orders whenever you want. Advance in your chosen field, earn bonuses and invest in greater profits. Or, if you prefer, do nothing at all - this world lets you choose your own way to live.

Social Life - The Key to New Connections

Social life in The Life Together Online is diverse. You can visit parks, cafés, bars, nightclubs and other locations where you’ll always have a chance to meet interesting people. New connections happen spontaneously - during a city walk, at a social venue or even at work, where a casual conversation with a customer could lead to something unexpected. Host a house party or attend one by invitation - it’s all up to you.

Communication and Interaction

Interact not only through voice chat but also via an intuitive in-game interface that allows you to send messages, exchange gifts and items and perform various shared activities. Build friendships, form romantic relationships and even become roommates with another player to share a home together.

A Unique Experience Awaits

The Life Together Online offers a one-of-a-kind experience, aiming to become a recognizable and beloved brand among players, as well as the first fully developed online life simulation game.

*Excluding NPCs that provide various services

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9400 / Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 10 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1060 (6 Gb) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 Gb)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 25 GB available space

short_description: Live, socialize, create! The Life Together Online is a unique online life simulator where every character is a real player. Work, make friends, customize your home, attend parties and travel. Complete freedom - choose your path and become part of a living world!

English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian
